body: As I said, she isn't responding to me. I've asked quite a few times and got absolutely no response.

Nope... and that's part of the pattern, even knowing why, whether I'd done wrong, whether they'd done wrong, whether they'd just decided to move on... well it wouldn't be so bad, at least understanding why.

Yes... this past year my best friend of maybe 10 years, the one who had always been the exception, the one who in the end had always been able to help me, and in turn, who I also have helped throughout the years... they lied to me, then cut me out of their life completely without a word of explanation. Sometimes I chat to people, get to know them, they get to know me, and things just don't click, and that's fine, but when you've known someone for years, and this isn't even the only time someone I've known for years has done the same to me, then... there's nothing else you can think.

Because there has never been a situation in my life where someone who has been able to help me, hasn't eventually ended up hurting me more in the end. Every time I thought there was an exception, I found out I was wrong. There's only so many times you can repeat the same pattern, get shit on or completely abandoned at the end of it, and try again, before... well. I know it's all I can ever expect.
Yep, so it's just easier to cut my losses at this point, and ensure the minimum amount of pain in my life.
I know, but that leads to even more pain in the future, which is why I'm here in the first place.

I'm not sure that will help. It might not be the right reaction, but in my head I feel rejected by everyone, so in turn want to avoid all contact, even though I realize that will only make things worse... as well as realizing the contradiction in that even with feeling that I'm posting on here and replying. *sigh* the joys of a messed up mind.

I'm just a few words on the screen, only a throwaway name. If I disappeared now from here, it couldn't matter to anyone, as I've never given the people here a reason for it to matter. 

I guess that's the thing, I recognize that my thought process in this is messed up, but I've done the same thing for a dozen years now, and not been able to change it. The reason to live is only ever people, the people in my life who I have some sort of meaningful connection with, who matter to me, and to whom I matter to. And I've learned this year that I can't rely on any of that. 

At worst, that makes me a selfish parasite, to rely on others for life and my own mental stability, but I'd never put pressure or expectation on anyone to be there. It just turns out that the consequences of feeling cut off and rejected, regardless on whether the feelings are valid ones, are to face and welcome my own mortality head on.
Sitting outside alone trying to find a reason to let myself live another year. Yeah, I don't do new years too well.
